images.title: The north entrance stands open
images.caption: The farm’s north gate served as a supply entrance. From inside the courtyard, the open gateway is an obvious weakness.
images.prompt: Create a single photorealistic, landscape-format historical reenactment still. Natural color as if professionally photographed on location; human, restrained, materially credible, candid composition. No captions, letters, maps, labels, watermark, collage or painted surface. Hougoumont farm, Waterloo Belgium, June 18 1815. Human eye level from INSIDE a walled Belgian brick farm courtyard toward an open tall double wooden carriage gate hung BETWEEN two square brick piers, continuous brick boundary wall adjoining them, no arch overhead. Red-coated British Guards with period black Belgic shakos, white crossbelts and flintlock muskets watching the entrance; no charging French yet. Damp dark ground, summer morning light, brick and timber outbuildings.

images.title: Shutting the gate
images.caption: Guardsmen close the doors after a French party has entered, cutting it off from the troops outside.
